newsitem.title: USA: MBNA securitizes $706 mln credit receivables.
newsitem.headline: MBNA securitizes $706 mln credit receivables.

text.p: MBNA Corp said Wednesday that its MBNA America Bank subsidiary has priced $706 million of five-year credit card asset backed securities.

The transaction, Series 1997-F, included $600 million Class A senior fixed rate asset backed certificates, $53 million of Class B subordinate floating rate asset backed certificates and a $53 million privately placed floating rate collateral invested amount.

The 5.0 year 6.60 percent Class A certificates were priced at 99.83007 percent. The 5.0 year Class B certificates accrue interest at 29 bps over the one month London Interbank Offered Rate ("LIBOR") and were priced at par.
The deal is scheduled to close June 18, MBNA said.
